name: Corporate Creations
old_description: Established in 1995 and based right here in Omaha Nebraska, Corporate Creations specializes in custom screen printing, embroidery and promotional products for the Omaha Metro area including Ralston, Bellevue, Millard, Elkhorn, LaVista and Papillion.
about:
Corporate Creations was founded in 1995 in Omaha, Nebraska, by Wade Lewis while he was an undergraduate at the University of Nebraska at Omaha. Lewis initially launched Greek Creations to serve fraternity and sorority merchandise needs, and the business expanded into Corporate Creations after friends and family requested similar custom screen printing, embroidery, and promotional products for their own organizations.

The company provides custom screen printing, embroidery, and promotional product sourcing from its facility at 9001 F Street in Omaha. It offers access to over 700,000 custom printed products and handles orders with minimums of six pieces for embroidery, twelve for screen printing, and 100 for most promotional items. An in-house graphic design team prepares artwork, with proofs delivered within 48 hours and two revisions included.

Corporate Creations serves businesses, clubs, teams, churches, charities, schools, and non-profit organizations throughout the Omaha metro area, including Ralston, Bellevue, Millard, Elkhorn, La Vista, and Papillion. Customers range from local companies seeking branded apparel to university groups ordering Greek merchandise.

Lewis started the business to simplify how college groups purchased custom merchandise, and the company states its goal is to exceed expectations and turn every client into a repeat customer. It emphasizes low minimums, quick art approvals, and rush production options to meet tight deadlines.
